blocks.value: If a rule instructs you to move a model as close as possible to a unit or model you must end that model’s move in base contact with that unit or model if its move is sufficient to do so without breaking any other restrictions (such as coherency), or as close as you can achieve if its move is not sufficient.

• If a model is already as close as possible to a unit or model when it is instructed to make a move as close as possible towards a unit or model, that model cannot be moved, but still counts as having made the move in question.

If a rule instructs you to move a model as close as possible to an objective you must end that model’s move within range of an objective if its move is sufficient to do so without breaking any other restrictions (such as coherency), or as close as you can achieve if its move is not sufficient.
• If that model is already within range of an objective it can move up to the maximum distance of that move but must end its move still within range of that objective.

requirements.summary: If objective range is unattainable, the move reaches the closest legal endpoint.
qualifications: Source gap: C01-12/P01L records that no real source-linked Core movement constraint and consumer implements the general as-close-as-possible objective fallback. The accepted Consolidation consumer is not a counterexample: selected 12.08 explicitly requires only a closer endpoint when objective range is unreachable, not the closest endpoint. Cogitated Need and Synaptic Goading contain objective as-close wording in load-only faction activation data; those placeholders do not establish Core execution. A real applicable source-linked consumer and witnessed closest-endpoint proof are required before certification.

boundary: P01L/C01-12 obligation06 only. One retained instruction binds a typed objective constraint through shared Normal movement; Consolidation 12.08 and Synaptic Goading remain unchanged.
